name: Viator Drakone
source:
Another sleepless night, another hungry day, another broken promise. 

A bitter and lonely foreigner sets out on a journey, becoming disappointed with every town, village and person he visits.

Time is running out and with each passing day, he knows the end is near. 

Will there be anyone worthy of his loyalty, his service and his life?

[Edited from [url=https://sahuaro-estudio.itch.io/viator-drakone]Itch.io[/url]]

A visual novel adaptation of [url=https://www.wattpad.com/story/327422467-viator-drakone-extranjero]Viator Drakone - Extranjero[/url].
translation:
又一个不眠之夜，又一个饥饿的一天，又一个违背的诺言。

一个痛苦而孤独的外国人踏上了旅程，对他所访问的每一个城镇、村庄和人都感到失望。

时间已经不多了，日子一天天过去，他知道末日已经临近。

会有人配得上他的忠诚、他的服务和他的生命吗？

[编辑自[url=https://sahuaro-estudio.itch.io/viator-drakone]Itch.io[/url]]

改编自 [url=https://www.wattpad.com/story/327422467-viator-drakone-extranjero]Viator Drakone - Extranjero[/url] 的视觉小说。
